name: Transpose
description: Rotates the picture by 90 degrees, optionally flipped, swapping its width and height.

params.name: dir
params.description: cclock_flip = 90 degrees counter-clockwise and flipped vertically, clock = 90 degrees clockwise, cclock = 90 degrees counter-clockwise, clock_flip = 90 degrees clockwise and flipped vertically

params.name: passthrough
params.description: Leave the picture as it is when it is already portrait (height >= width) or landscape (width >= height)
